capability.summary: User explicitly authorizes product implementation: undo/redo, bulk pattern editing, named sections and controlled variations with audition/apply/discard in the existing design. This instruction overrides the default GA-only scope. Arrange Song follows this editing foundation in a later release.

controls.description: Bounded undo/redo with one entry per gesture or bulk action; notes, sound and section metadata; song loads reset history.
controls.test: Chrome GUI/API grouping, redo invalidation, sample and effect restoration, load boundaries, save conflicts.

controls.description: Phrase/bar/track selections, copy/paste/clear/repeat/nudge/transpose through shared APIs.
controls.test: Cross-phrase, all-track operations, mono constraints, bounds and atomic rejection, one-step undo.

controls.description: Named nonoverlapping phrase groups with duration, duplication, move and resize; JSON and database persistence.
controls.test: Legacy defaults, invalid metadata rejection, roundtrip, sections/notes remain aligned during edits.

controls.description: Deterministic sparse/driving/syncopated/answer patterns on selected unlocked tracks; isolated full-mix preview and explicit apply/discard.
controls.test: Locked and unselected data unchanged, pitch/mono invariants, audition cancellation, stale preview rejection, no preview autosave, exact undo.
